What do EL clients feel is necessary and beneficial in terms of testing. Confirm May 1st deployment EL clients with dropped pre-merge history enabled. - Confirm mainnet go-live timeline in conjunction with the Pectra fork. Can anyone explain me why can' t some clients start dropping Sepolia right now? as long as geth doesn't drop those blocks will be there, there' s no need for coordination and it will definitely help us know that CL clients are working towards this I think it's about sync. It'll degrade the sync performance of the clients that haven't dropped yet. Probably not a hard blocker but worth considering. I would also like us to get an export of the pre merge sepolia history as era files. Would any of the EL clients be able to do this? will look and see if we can do this with our era package now Isn’t that already here? https://eth-clients.github.io/history-endpoints/#sepolia Awesome. I wasn't aware that was already done ^ <@403636673914863626> A meta-EIP was suggested in the call today as the manner to formally communicate and document 4444s plans. I'll plan on getting something submitted in this format soon unless I hear strong preferences for another format or manner of presenting this information.

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
Revised set of things that I believe should be discussed and/or agreed on in the call today.

- Move towards finalizing eth/69 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9237  - PR discussion suggests that there is still work to do.
- Testing needs.  What do EL clients feel is necessary and beneficial in terms of testing.  Confirm May 1st deployment EL clients with dropped pre-merge history enabled.
- Confirm mainnet go-live timeline in conjunction with the Pectra fork.
